# Operator Packet

Read-only planning artifact. This is an Operator plan packet, **not** a greenlight.
It plans a proof-bearing cleanup; per `OPERATOR_VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL.md` the
implementation/proof phases must run as Codex-approved **FullOperator** runs.
This ReadOnly profile cannot build, stage, capture, scan binary assets, run Unreal,
or perform git/filesystem deletes, and it cannot reach paths outside `C:\UE\T66`.

- Operator: Claude (`claude-opus-4-8`, ReadOnly Operator)
- Validator / Finisher: Codex
- Validation depth: full (destructive deletes, serialized save fields, mid-enum
  removal, CoreRedirects, Unreal asset references, staged build + capture proof)
- Helper / profile: `Scripts\Invoke-ClaudeReadOnlyOperator.ps1` (ReadOnly, no approval, cannot mutate)

---

# Task Contract

```text
Working task:
Plan a single deprecated-code cleanup pass across the lightweight-mob and
roster-restructure work. Delete: rich-basic-mob routing path only (preserve rich
miniboss/special/boss); inert lightweight/routing/touch CVars; deprecated
enemy/boss projectile actor classes; GamblerToken legacy enum value, legacy
save/profile fields, and Item_GamblersToken alias (no migration). Remove the named
CoreRedirects ONLY if a binary/source/config/data scan proves the old
property/function names are unreferenced; otherwise keep them. Delete the approved
B.13 sandbox worktree C:\UE\T66_B13_Worktree after evidence-preservation checks.
Operator:    Claude (claude-opus-4-8), ReadOnly Operator (planning phase only)
Validator:   Codex (approval gate, validation, final reporter)
Scope:       Read-only planning. No edits/deletes/build/stage/capture/git this phase.
Stop:        This packet written. Implementation waits on Codex approval per phase.
```

Out of scope (do not touch): Mini/minigame systems; rich miniboss/special/boss
spawn code; the route-attribution diagnostics' intended behavior; broad Git/LFS
scans; any git stage/commit/revert/clean. No production behavior change intended.

---

# Live Anchor Findings

Every target below was confirmed against current source/config (anchors are `path:line`).

## 1. Rich-basic-mob routing path (preserve miniboss/special/boss)

The basic-mob A/B split is retired: all basic families route lightweight
unconditionally; the rich path is reached only for miniboss/special/boss.

- `Source\T66\Gameplay\T66EnemyDirector.cpp:99-102` — `T66IsLightweightMobRoutingEnabled()` hardcoded `return true`.
- `T66EnemyDirector.cpp:104-117` — `T66ShouldRouteRushToLightweight/Flying/Ranged` all `[[maybe_unused]]`, hardcoded `return true` (dead).
- `T66EnemyDirector.cpp:709-727` (decl `T66EnemyDirector.h:134`) — `ShouldRouteSpawnToLightweightMob(...)` ignores `bUseLightweightRouting` (`(void)` at :717); returns true for Melee/Rush/Flying/Ranged, false for None/MiniBoss/Special. This is the live gate that preserves rich routing for miniboss/special/boss.
- `T66EnemyDirector.cpp:119-145` — `T66ResolveRouteAttributionReason(...)` still has a `!bUseLightweightRouting` branch (`RoutedRich_CVarOff`) that is now unreachable, plus reachable miniboss/special/fallback reasons.
- Two spawn loops thread `bUseLightweightRouting` (always true): initial-population `T66EnemyDirector.cpp:490,528,605`; staggered-batch `:1457,1466,1599`. In each, the `bShouldRouteLightweight==false` else-branch (`:572-608`, `:1533-1601`) is the **shared rich spawn path** — it still serves miniboss/special/boss (`bIsMiniBoss`, `!bIsMob`), so it **must not be deleted wholesale**. The dead part is the now-unreachable basic-family rich attribution, not the rich spawn itself.

Sanction for this cleanup: `Source\T66\Gameplay\pending_issues_Gameplay.md:40` ("rich
basic-mob path is deprecated dead code pending cleanup") and `:42` ("Cleanup pass
should delete deprecated rich-basic routing branches and inert routing CVars after
B.13/B.14 validates the final rendering path").

## 2. Inert lightweight / routing / touch CVars

All five are registered, documented `DEPRECATED-...: inert`, and read by always-true helpers:

- `T66EnemyDirector.cpp:51-60` `T66.Mob.UseLightweight`
- `T66EnemyDirector.cpp:63-72` `T66.Mob.Diagnostics.RouteRushLightweight`
- `T66EnemyDirector.cpp:75-84` `T66.Mob.Diagnostics.RouteFlyingLightweight`
- `T66EnemyDirector.cpp:87-96` `T66.Mob.Diagnostics.RouteRangedLightweight`
- `Source\T66\Gameplay\T66MobManagerSubsystem.cpp:60-69` `T66.Mob.Diagnostics.UseTouchDamageOverlap`; consumed only by `ShouldUseTouchDamageOverlap()` (`:116-121`, hardcoded `return true`, `(void)` cast); called at `:737`.

**String-literal back-references that survive CVar deletion** (these read the CVars by name and would silently return defaults, leaving dangling references — a cleanup-completeness item, not a crash):
- `T66MobManagerSubsystem.cpp:2232-2235` (`ReadRouteCVarInt(...)` in the `[RouteAttributionSummary]` log).
- `Source\T66\Gameplay\T66PlayerController_Overlays.cpp` — extensive smoke/automation plumbing sets/reads these CVars by name: `:1737-1740,1894-1897,1911-1914,2114-2117,2333-2344,2665-2668,2853-2876,2888-2912,2958-2963`. Note these also parse command-line knobs (`T66MobUseLightweight=`, `T66MobRouteFlyingLightweight=`, etc.). Deleting the CVars without reconciling these smoke paths leaves dead/no-op automation branches.

## 3. Deprecated enemy/boss projectile actor classes

Both classes are explicitly deprecated and have **no spawn sites**; manager owns projectiles now.

- `Source\T66\Gameplay\Enemies\Projectiles\T66EnemyProjectileBase.h:16-19` (`// DEPRECATED ... owned by UT66ProjectileManagerSubsystem`) + `.cpp`.
- `Source\T66\Gameplay\T66BossProjectile.h:17-26` (deprecated; ctor marked `UE_DEPRECATED(5.7, ...)`) + `.cpp`.
- Only live references: the cleanup-filter `IsA` checks at `Source\T66\Gameplay\GameMode\T66GameMode_Backrooms.cpp:151-152` and the two includes at `:7,10`. No `SpawnActor`/`StaticClass` construction sites found in `Source\` (grep for `EnemyProjectileBase::StaticClass|BossProjectile::StaticClass|SpawnActor.*Projectile|FireInDirection|SetTargetLocation` returns only defs + the filter).
- **Caveat**: both are `UCLASS(Blueprintable)`. A C++ deletion is unsafe until a binary asset scan proves no Blueprint subclass / level / data reference exists. Read-only profile cannot scan `.uasset`.

## 4. GamblerToken legacy enum value, fields, item alias

These are **not uniformly dead** — some are live save-compat bridges using a legacy name.

- **Enum value** `ET66SecondaryStatType::GamblerToken` — `Source\T66\Data\T66DataTypes.h:917` (mid-enum, `: uint8`, decl at `:867`), and listed in `T66IsDeprecatedSecondaryStatType` at `:936`. Live runtime/UI guard it as legacy alongside canonical `VendorToken` (`:924`):
  - `Source\T66\Core\RunState\T66RunStateSubsystem_Private.h:296`, `Source\T66\Core\RunState\T66RunStateSubsystem_EconomyInventory.cpp:961`, `Source\T66\UI\T66ItemCardTextUtils.cpp:50,96`, `Source\T66\Core\T66LocalizationSubsystem.cpp:312,385,596`, `Source\T66\Core\Backend\T66BackendRunSummaryParser.cpp:164` (legacy backend key).
  - `Content\Data\Items.csv:31` uses `VendorToken` (no live row references GamblerToken).
- **Item-ID alias** `Item_GamblersToken` — pure legacy OR-checks for old saves: `T66RunStateSubsystem_Private.h:39,254-255`, `T66GameInstance.cpp:34,46,57`, `T66HUDPresentationController.cpp:901`, `T66PlayerController_Combat.cpp:127`, `T66PlayerController_Overlays.cpp:371`. Canonical is `Item_VendorToken`.
- **Save/profile fields (LIVE persistence under a legacy name — highest risk):**
  - `Source\T66\Core\T66RunSaveGame.h:378` `ActiveGamblersTokenLevel` — the serialized snapshot field; bridged to the live runtime member `ActiveVendorTokenLevel` at `T66RunStateSubsystem_Snapshot.cpp:27` (capture) and `:171` (restore). Runtime member is `T66RunStateSubsystem.h:1529`.
  - `Source\T66\Core\T66ProfileSaveGame.h:132` `GamblersTokenUnlockedLevel` — serialized profile field, read/written in `T66AchievementsSubsystem.cpp:313,1213,1230,1240`.
  - The renamed accessors already exist and are canonical: `ApplyVendorTokenPickup` / `GetActiveVendorTokenLevel` (`T66RunStateSubsystem.h:698,702`), `GetVendorTokenUnlockedLevel` (`T66AchievementsSubsystem.h:218`).
  - **Consequence**: deleting these struct fields removes the persistence of vendor-token level. Renaming them to VendorToken-named fields is a save-format change; with "no migration," old saves reset that value to 0. This is a deliberate behavior decision, not dead-code removal — flagged below.

## 5. CoreRedirects (conditional)

`Config\DefaultEngine.ini` `[CoreRedirects]` (`:2`). In-scope entries:
- Property redirects `:16` `GameplayFloorsPerStage→MobFloorsPerStage`, `:17` `InitialEnemiesPerGameplayFloor→InitialEnemiesPerMobFloor`, `:18` `InitialTowerEnemiesPerGameplayFloor→InitialTowerEnemiesPerMobFloor`.
- Function redirects `:20` `ApplyGamblersTokenPickup→ApplyVendorTokenPickup`, `:21` `GetActiveGamblersTokenLevel→GetActiveVendorTokenLevel`.
- The new (NewName) symbols exist in source (confirmed in §1/§4). The OLD names do not exist in source. Out of scope: EnumRedirects `:7-9`, BodyType, ArcadeInteractable, etc.

## 6. B.13 sandbox worktree

- `C:\UE\T66_B13_Worktree` is **outside this profile's allowed root** (`C:\UE\T66`); `Test-Path` was blocked. **This ReadOnly Operator cannot verify its existence, resolve its absolute path, or confirm preserved evidence.** A FullOperator/Codex phase must do the resolve-and-equality check and the evidence sweep before any delete.
- Durable evidence appears already preserved under the live repo: `Reports\AgentReviews\20260529_B13_NoLand_Closeout\preserved_worktree_evidence\` (multiple `T66_B13_*HISMProof*.log`), per the closeout folder name — the implementing phase must confirm this preserves every applicable proof class (`OPERATOR_VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL.md` Evidence Preservation Before Deletion).

# CoreRedirect Verification Plan

The redirects bridge OLD serialized names that Blueprints / DataTables / cooked
assets may still reference. **Do not assume safety.** Remove a redirect only after
proving the old name is unreferenced across source, config, data, and binary assets.

Old names to scan: `GameplayFloorsPerStage`, `InitialEnemiesPerGameplayFloor`,
`InitialTowerEnemiesPerGameplayFloor`, `ApplyGamblersTokenPickup`,

Method (FullOperator phase; this profile cannot do steps 2-3):

2. **Binary asset scan** — search `.uasset`/`.umap` for references to the old property/function names and to the deprecated projectile classes (`AT66EnemyProjectileBase`, `AT66BossProjectile`) and `Item_GamblersToken`. Narrow path checks only — no broad LFS hashing.
3. **Decision rule (per redirect):**
   - If ANY asset/config/data/source still references an old name → **leave that redirect in place**; report the exact referencing assets/lines; do not delete.
   - If clean across all scans → remove that redirect line from `[CoreRedirects]`.
4. Record scan commands, outputs, and per-redirect keep/remove decisions in the completion packet.

---

# Risks / Decisions

- **[Blocker — Pablo decision] GamblerToken save/profile fields are live persistence, not dead code.**
  `ActiveGamblersTokenLevel` (`T66RunSaveGame.h:378`) and `GamblersTokenUnlockedLevel`
  (`T66ProfileSaveGame.h:132`) currently store the vendor-token level under a legacy
  name. "Delete the legacy fields, no migration" would drop vendor-token persistence.
  Choose: (a) **rename** to VendorToken-named fields — old saves reset that value to
  0 (save-format change, "no migration" accepted); (b) **keep** the legacy field
  names as-is (delete enum value + alias only, leave save fields untouched — zero
  save impact); (c) rename **and** add an EnumRedirect/save-upgrade to preserve old
  values. Recommend (b) unless Pablo wants the names cleaned, in which case (a).
- **[Major — Pablo/Codex] Mid-enum removal of `GamblerToken` (`T66DataTypes.h:917`).**
  `ET66SecondaryStatType : uint8` is serialized by entry **name** (tagged-property),
  so removing a middle value does **not** reindex others. But any legacy save/DataTable
  holding `GamblerToken` resolves to `None` on load unless an `+EnumRedirects=(...GamblerToken→VendorToken)`
  is added. Live data (`Items.csv:31`) is already `VendorToken`, so no live row is
  affected. Decision: accept None-fallback ("no migration") vs add an EnumRedirect.
- **[Major] Deprecated projectile classes are `Blueprintable`.** Deletion is unsafe
  until Phase 0 proves no Blueprint subclass / level / DataTable reference. ReadOnly
  profile cannot scan binary assets — hard gate.
- **[Major — decision] Route-attribution diagnostics degrade after CVar removal.**
  `T66MobManagerSubsystem.cpp:2226+` `[RouteAttributionSummary]` and the
  `T66PlayerController_Overlays.cpp` smoke/automation plumbing read the deleted CVars
  by string and parse command-line knobs. Options: (a) minimal — delete CVar
  registrations, leave the now-default-returning `ReadRouteCVarInt` lookups
  (functional, but dangling stale references); (b) thorough — also simplify the
  degenerate diagnostics/smoke branches. The diagnostics' *intended behavior* is
  out of scope per the contract; recommend (b) only to the extent needed to remove
  dead CVar-name references, and document the rest as a pending issue. Codex to
  confirm scope boundary.
- **[Major] Shared rich spawn branch.** The `else` spawn branches
  (`T66EnemyDirector.cpp:572-608`, `:1533-1601`) serve miniboss/special/boss and must
  survive. Risk of over-deletion; Phase 1 must remove only the inert
  basic-family routing plumbing, not the spawn path.
- **[Blocker for Phase 5 — capability] Worktree path is outside this profile's root.**
  Existence, absolute-path resolution, and evidence-preservation could not be
  verified here. FullOperator/Codex must perform the equality check and evidence
  sweep before delete.
- **[Process] Proof-bearing routing.** This packet (ReadOnly) plans only; it cannot
  satisfy the build/stage/SHA/capture/scan requirements. Each implementation phase
  must be a separate Codex-approved FullOperator run with its own completion packet;
  Codex remains final proof owner and reporter.
